title: The Hymn of Harrow Glen
author: Coral Reyes
blurb: Wendell Okonkwo, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
